questions.topic: PrepLadder · 003-All India NEET SS Grand Test 3-13th Sep 2023
questions.stem: A 34-year-old bilateral lung recipient currently on tacrolimus 0.1 mg/kg/day is developing a progressive cough and dyspnea. He reports that 5 months ago he had “the flu” and since then has been unable to get rid of the coughing spells. His dyspnea is getting worse, and the symptoms are unabating. A CT of the chest shows hyperinflation and patchy areas of inflammation. Bronchoscopy is unrevealing except for few gram-negative bacteria. What is the best course of action?

options.label: D
options.text: Increase the steroid dose in conjunction with Atrovent and albuterol
